description: This is a C source file implementing arbitrary precision number arithmetic functions for big number operations, including multiplication, squaring, and division, used within cryptographic libraries. The file contains functions like bn_mul_add_words, bn_mul_words, bn_sqr_words, and bn_div_words.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Performs multiplication and addition of words, updating the result array and returning carry.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies words and adds carry, storing result in the provided array and returning carry.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n)
methods.description: Squares an array of words storing the result in another array.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h,BN_ULONG l,BN_ULONG d)
methods.description: Divides a 64-bit number (split into high and low 32 bits) by a 32-bit divisor, returning the quotient.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_add_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,BN_ULONG * b,int n)
methods.description: Adds two arrays of words, with support for 64-bit and 32-bit implementations depending on compilation flags.
